requirements.label: Choose one of the following:
notes: An Advanced Placement (AP) Mathematics Test with a score of 3 or higher

CJ 1340.title: Criminal Investigations
CJ 1340.prereqText: CJ 1010 ; CJ 1390 is also strongly recommended as a pre- or co-requisite for Criminal Justice majors

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.

MAT 1030.title: Quantitative Reasoning
MAT 1030.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 1020 (preferred), or MAT1015 or MAT 1010 with a grade of C– or higher; or appropriate placement by a placement exam.

MAT 1035.title: Quantitative Reasoning with Integrated Algebra
MAT 1035.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 0950 with a grade of C- or higher, or MAT 0980 with a grade of C- or higher, or appropriate placement by a placement exam.

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1055.title: College Algebra with Preliminaries
MATH 1055.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

STAT 1040.title: Introduction to Statistics
STAT 1040.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score

STAT 1045.title: Introduction to Statistics with Algebra
STAT 1045.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score
